description: Real motion primitives measured off the live original by reading GSAP calls / intercepting CanvasRenderingContext2D, per src/hooks/useMotion.js and src/hooks/useHeroIntro.js's own documentation comments. Every value here is quoted from those files' own doc comments, not re-derived.

reducedMotion.verificationNote: Independently grepped for 'prefers-reduced-motion|matchMedia' across src/ during this build — all 6 real occurrences above confirmed directly; the README's claim ('All motion respects prefers-reduced-motion', README.md:55) reproduces.

revealVocabulary.description: Named scroll-reveal patterns, quoted verbatim from useMotion.js's own doc comment (lines 12-24). All are 'top 80%' ScrollTrigger start, play-once.

splitTextSubstitute.note: SplitText and DrawSVG are paid GSAP Club plugins; the reference uses both. This project reproduces them by hand rather than bundling the paid plugins.
splitTextSubstitute.splitText: A DOM word/line splitter (src/hooks/useMotion.js splitMasked()) using overflow:clip mask wrappers, reproducing the reference's exact numbers above.
splitTextSubstitute.drawSvg: stroke-dasharray animation (setLineDash-equivalent for SVG paths) used for the about/team/values tag-line and zig-zag SVGs (src/pages/AboutUs.jsx) and the canvas connector's setLineDash (src/components/FeatureConnector.jsx).
splitTextSubstitute.scrollSmoother: Deliberately NOT used, per README.md:40 and useMotion.js's own scope.

featureConnector.strokeOrder: track (oat #e2e1d3) then progress (blue #0b4fff), lineWidth 3, arcTo 40px corners
featureConnector.drawIn: setLineDash([drawn, pathLen]), drawn sweeping 0 -> pathLen-10, progress ramp from top=0.75*vh to top=0.40*vh

ctaDotField.renderModel: Visually static field; original runs a 60fps rAF loop repainting identical arcs, this build redraws once per size change instead of burning frame budget.

productHeroDotField.canvasType: CSS radial-gradient on a 20px tile — NOT canvas. Explicitly distinct from the two canvas fields above; do not conflate.

productHeroTimeline.description: Master timeline where each tag pill cues its own column's content, per-group y-offsets on the agent-hero variant.
productHeroTimeline.cueTiming: tag1 @1.11s then 3 user cards cascade ~0.15s apart; tag2 @2.04s then ingest; tag3 @2.50s then offers; tag4 @2.96s then cards; tag5 then experience.
